accuracyFormula.$comment: Hit probability; the result is clamped to zero through one.

accuracyPerHit.$comment: Roll accuracy for each hit rather than once per move.

aiScoreFormula.$comment: Score used by the strongest opponent policy.

captureFormula.$comment: Capture probability; the result is clamped to zero through one.

captureGivesExperience.$comment: Whether a successful capture grants experience.

criticalIgnoresStages.$comment: Ignore attack and defense stages on critical hits.

criticalPerHit.$comment: Roll critical chance independently for each hit.

damageFormula.$comment: Damage expression; type-chart immunity still prevents damage.

defeatRecovery.$comment:
Fraction of maximum health restored after defeat.

encountersAfterWarp.$comment: Allow encounter checks at warp destinations.

experienceForFainted.$comment: Allow fainted recipients to gain experience.

experienceFormula.$comment: Total experience threshold for a level.

fallbackMove.$comment:

simultaneousDefeatWins.$comment: Treat a simultaneous final faint as a victory.

stageLimit.$comment: Absolute limit on temporary stat stages.

statFormula.$comment: Combat stat calculated from its base value and level.

switchPriority.$comment: Action priority for a voluntary switch.

tieBreak.$comment: Equal-speed order: player, opponent or random.

typeChart.$comment: Attack type to defending type multipliers.

remaining.$comment: Remaining turns; absent means until cured.

hitPoints.$comment: Current HP, from zero to maxHitPoints inclusive.

amount.$comment: Signed HP change; supports damage, hp and maxHP variables.
